confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence. Hostel and hotel rates are less certain given July holiday-season demand and 2026 price drift. Cocktail and wine anchors were bounded using the local beer relationship (about 3.0x and 2.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was matched precisely. The basis is general Colombian capital-city price levels from general knowledge, not live data.
